sub_answers.text: In the NHS and social care sector Welsh Labour's 2021 manifesto included schemes to invest in mental health services, to create a new medical school in North Wales, and to move towards free-at-point-of-use social care ideally as part of UK-wide reform (2021) [d33580665s8p0].
